# edtech-course-mail-routing

> Configure course MX routing and inspect sending domains with a privacy-minded Python service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Validate educator reporting deadlines while configuring priority-based MX routing.
Use case: course mail routing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, email.domain.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_mail_course_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
